## Shared · Send message
Every automation hands its texts and emails to this workflow, so there is one place to switch sending on or off.

**Demo mode:** messages are logged to the Outbox table only.
**Live:** add Twilio and SMTP credentials, enable the two grey nodes, then set `sms_enabled` / `email_enabled` to `true` in the Config table.

Messages to fictional demo addresses (+64 21 000 xxxx and *.example) are never sent, even when live sending is on.

nodes.name: Send SMS (Twilio)
nodes.notes: Add your Twilio credential and a sender number, then enable.

nodes.name: Send email (SMTP)
nodes.notes: Add your SMTP credential and a sender address, then enable.

meta.description: The only workflow that sends SMS or email. Demo mode logs everything to the Outbox table.
